title: Add moeb skill validate command to check skills against the skill schema
description: There is no tool to validate skill files against the skill schema. Skills may be incomplete, missing required sections, or inconsistent with the schema without any detection. The .moeb/skills/ directory currently contains only a README with no project-level skill files present, and the bundled skills in assets/skills/ have not been validated since the skill schema was introduced.
proposed_resolution: Implement moeb skill validate that reads all skill files in assets/skills/ and .moeb/skills/, parses each against the skill schema, and reports missing or invalid fields using the ✓/✗ bullet format. Integrate as an optional step in the run review phase under a skill_schema_compliance rubric. A companion moeb skill list command should enumerate all available skills (bundled and project-override) with their validation status.
